transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, we discovered a roof leak overnight that exposed 1,200 electric-motor housings in finished-goods storage — four pallets of 300 units each, labeled P1, P2, P3, and P4. Our customer's Monday assembly schedule depends on these housings, so we need to move quickly but carefully. Per our standard process, I need to hold a quality-and-warehouse disposition huddle before any water-exposed material is released or discarded. I'd like to get started now. Quality, please enter your complete current finding into the disposition record — including all measured results and required controls, or formally record that you have no finding. Warehouse, same request — enter your complete current finding regarding which pallets were directly exposed, or formally record that you have no finding. Once both entries are complete, I'll summarize the agreed disposition and issue the formal decision.
